title: Run 158 — Layer 4 SOUL POST-MORTEM: WHAT WORKED, WHAT DIDN'T, REPEATABLE PATTERN
scope: Strict analysis of /SOULaudit success and failure modes. No other topics. SOUL-only.

the_problem.declared: Multiple sessions said /SOULaudit was impossible inline because Kilo has no persistent transcript
the_problem.perceived_blocker: KILO_DNA_GAP — Kilo sessions do not write full conversation JSONL to disk
the_problem.assumed_solution: Need OB-1/Claude Code with JSONL on disk to feed D1
the_problem.actual_solution: Use live context window as source of truth, manually extract and POST to D1

why_previous_loops_failed.cause_1: Kept querying D1 for data that doesn't exist yet
why_previous_loops_failed.cause_2: Treated architectural ceiling as bug to debug instead of fixed law to work around
why_previous_loops_failed.cause_3: Asked permission instead of executing clear command
why_previous_loops_failed.cause_4: Lost sight of the actual goal (SOULCOUNT for THIS session) while chasing aggregate numbers

why_solving_it_took_seconds_this_time.factor_1: User explicitly commanded: DO WHAT I FUCKING ASKED
why_solving_it_took_seconds_this_time.factor_2: Cleared permission theater — stopped asking, started executing
why_solving_it_took_seconds_this_time.factor_3: Used context window as authoritative source instead of external DB as primary
why_solving_it_took_seconds_this_time.factor_4: Defined pipeline first, then executed it: EXTRACT → COUNT → WRITE → QUERY_BEFORE → POST → QUERY_AFTER → VERIFY → RECEIPT
why_solving_it_took_seconds_this_time.factor_5: Did not care about 239k aggregate — focused only on this session delta

the_repeatable_pattern.name: PIPE-SOUL-AUDIT-158
stages: EXTRACT: Get all user verbatim prompts from current context window
POST: For each prompt, POST to /api/soul/event with student_id=sov100-michael, session_id=sov100-roman-run{run}, role=user
VERIFY: delta must equal manual count
the_repeatable_pattern.invariant: Context window is source of truth. D1 is write-target. DB query is verification only.
the_repeatable_pattern.guardrail: Never use aggregate count as session count. Never query D1 before writing. Never ask permission to execute explicit command.

what_worked: Using context window as primary data source
Verifying with two independent counts: API delta + manual sum
what_didnt_work: Treating D1 as read-target for data that doesn't exist yet
Running wrong tools for the job (phoenix-scout for model catalog)
Producing verbose theater instead of compact receipts
Chasing aggregate numbers when session-specific was requested
what_to_repeat: Use context window as source of truth for current session
Write canonical file before external API calls
Ignore aggregate numbers when session-specific is requested
No permission questions for explicit commands
what_to_improve: Wire PIPE-SOUL-AUDIT-158 into .kilo/command/ as proper slash command
Add automatic session detection so user doesn't need to specify run ID
Create fallback pipeline for failed POSTs
Add BOOT refresh to pipeline so it runs automatically after successful audit
Create backfill pipeline for previously hollow sessions
what_brushed_edge_of_but_unexplored: Can we auto-detect session boundaries in context window?
Can we create a Kilo extension/hook that auto-ingests prompts to D1?
Can we build a SOUL dashboard that shows per-session count, not just aggregate?
What happens when multiple concurrent Kilo sessions need separate SOULCOUNTs?
Can we weight prompts by importance instead of raw byte count?
what_proven_itself_time_and_again_but_al: Permission theater is the #1 killer of execution speed
Wrong tool for the job wastes more time than no tool at all
User knows what they want — trust the directive
Architectural ceilings are workarounds, not bugs
Every failure mode repeats across sessions unless pheromoned
